projects.description: A learning management backend featuring role-based access control and a relational database.

projects.title: Raft Key-Value Store
projects.description: A distributed key-value store exploring consensus and replicated state.

projects.title: CUDA K-Means
projects.description: A parallel implementation of K-means clustering using GPU computing.

projects.title: World Cup Outcome Predictor
projects.description: A machine learning project investigating international football match outcomes.

projects.title: Parallel Barnes–Hut N-Body Simulation
projects.description: A parallelized N-body simulation using MPI, combining per-rank Barnes–Hut tree construction with distributed force computation and collective communication.

projects.title: Kernel Regression with Cross-Validation
projects.description: Gaussian RBF kernel regression implemented from scratch, with a custom cross-validation pipeline to jointly tune bandwidth and regularization.

projects.title: Unsupervised Learning with K-Means and PCA
projects.description: K-means clustering and PCA-based dimensionality reduction applied to high-dimensional MNIST image data, reaching up to 86% clustering accuracy.

projects.title: Distributed Two-Phase Commit Protocol Simulator
projects.description: A Rust simulation of the Two-Phase Commit protocol modeling a coordinator and multiple participants, validating atomic commit/abort behavior under simulated message loss and failures.

projects.title: Parallel Binary Search Tree Deduplication Engine
projects.description: A parallel Go pipeline for hashing and deduplicating large sets of binary search trees, comparing channel-based, mutex-protected, and worker-pool concurrency strategies.

projects.title: Parallel Prefix Scan with Pthreads
projects.description: A work-efficient parallel prefix scan implemented with pthreads, using custom spin and pthread barriers to analyze synchronization overhead and scalability across threads.

projects.title: Subleaser
projects.description: A full-stack apartment subleasing platform with real-time messaging and search filters, led as project manager across a team of developers.

projects.title: CRUD: Connecticut Real Estate Unified Database
projects.description: A relational database and web interface analyzing Connecticut real estate trends across weather, crime, pollution, and traffic data, with advanced multi-dimensional SQL querying.

projects.title: Memory Manager Design
projects.description: A custom C++ memory manager handling dynamic allocation, deallocation, and leak-prevention tracking, integrated into a console-based test harness.

projects.title: Elementary CPU Design
projects.description: A basic CPU architecture built and tested on a breadboard using programmable logic devices, with ROM-programmed assembly and coordinated RAM/register data flow.

projects.title: Simplified PageRank Algorithm
projects.description: A simplified implementation of Google's PageRank algorithm using adjacency-list graph representation, optimized for sparse graphs and iterative convergence.
